input.title: Milano Cookies Allergen Alert
input.content: Milano is recalling packages of Cookies because undeclared peanuts may affect customers with severe allergies. Customers should not consume the product and should return it to the store for a refund.

planner.summary: Milano is recalling cookies due to undeclared peanuts, risking allergic reactions and offering refunds.
